note: AN3b: state transitions. A case sets `option` at T0 and settles (a live case: `first` settled at T0, `option` at T1 as an event at 0); then at each sample t of samplesMs: the events at t (over: handler.mousemove at x,y; out: mousemove at 3,3; action: dispatchAction; setOption: notMerge, which flushes on its own), then NOW = T1 + t and one zr.animation.update() unless a setOption flushed (clips step, then _onframe applies the changed states), then the record. Element keys as advchart-animation-update.json, plus z2, states (currentStates joined), style.stroke "null" for a path without one; stateAnimators: per sample the element's animators with __fromStateTransition, as name:targetName; transition: el.stateTransition as duration/easing/delay.

cases.note: hover bar C at 0, out at 500: the fill lifts and comes back, 300 ms cubicOut each way
hover at 0, out at 100 (mid-transition), over again at 200: each from the current value
hover C at 0, move to D at 150: C leaves and D enters in the same frame
dispatchAction highlight at 0, downplay at 500
selectedMode single: select at 0 (border colour assigned, width tweened 1 -> 2), unselect at 500
select B at 0, hover B at 400 (the lift from the select fill), out at 800
two series, emphasis.focus series: hovering series 0 blurs series 1 (opacity 1 -> 0.1), out at 500
highlight with focus self by action at 0 (the others blur), downplay at 500
stateAnimation {duration: 600, easing: linear, delay: 50}
a root-level stateAnimation {duration: 200, easing: quadraticIn} reaches the series

animation: false: no stateTransition at all, the state is set at once
hover slice b at 0: r grows by scaleSize 5, the fill lifts; out at 500
select b at 0: the slice, its label and its label line slide by selectedOffset; unselect at 500

emphasis.scale 1.6 and an emphasis colour
